manual_discovery_ip_addresses.label: Fully Kiosk devices
manual_discovery_ip_addresses.description: List of Fully Kiosk devices to connect to. Enter one device per line as host or host:port. Port defaults to 2323 if not specified. After saving, configure the password (and optional SSL options) for each device on the individual player's settings page.

password.label: [%key:common::config_entries::password::label%]
password.description: Password to use to connect to the Fully Kiosk API.

use_ssl.label: Use HTTPS when connecting to the Fully Kiosk API.

verify_ssl.label: Verify HTTPS certificates (recommended).
verify_ssl.description: Disabling verification trusts any certificate (no validation).

ssl_fingerprint.label: TLS certificate fingerprint
ssl_fingerprint.description: Optional SHA-256 hex fingerprint. When provided it must match the device certificate and overrides the verify setting.
